arabic text:
AYE BAD-E-SABA JA KE YE AMMO KO BATANA PYASI HAI
SAKINA(SA).
ISS CHOTE SE SIN MEIN YEH SITAM MAIN NE UTHAYE.
ALLAH KISSI KO NA YATEEM AISA BANAYE.
KHUD APNE LAHO MEIN KOI BACHI NA NAHAYE.
MAIN TUM KO BOLATI RAHI TUM BHI TU NA AYE.
MAIN BAN GAYI BAD-ASAL LAEENO KA NISHANA PYASI HAI
SAKINA(SA).
english translation text:
O morning breeze, go and tell my
uncle: Sakina is thirsty. At this young
age I have endured such cruelty. May
Allah never make anyone such an orphan.
May no child be bathed in her
own blood. I kept calling you, yet
you did not come. I became the
target of the accursed ones—Sakina is thirsty.

arabic text:
PANI KI TALAB MUJH KO KHILATI RAHI THOKAR.
KEHTA THA LAEEN DOON GA MAIN FOJON KO PILA KAR.
JAB SHIMAR LAEEN KAR CHUKA SAIRAB YEH LASHKAR.
DIKHLA KE MUJHE PHAINK DIYA PANI ZAMEEN PAR.
TAB SAMJHI MAIN KYA HOOTA HAI UMEED DILANA PYASI HAI
SAKINA(SA).
english translation text:
My longing for water kept throwing me to the
ground. The accursed one said he would give me
water after the army had drunk. When Shimr had
quenched the entire army, he showed me water and
poured it upon the earth. Then I learned what
it means to give someone false hope—Sakina is thirsty.

arabic text:
IK JAAM HOWA SHAM-E-GHAREEBAN MEIN MUYASAR.
WOH KOZA MAIN RAKH AYI THI ASGHAR(AS) KI LAHAD PAR.
THA MUJH SE BHI CHOTA MERA BAHIYA MERA DILBAR.
SHARMINDA MAIN HO JATI CHACHA PYAS BHUJA KAR.
AB APNE HI HATHON SE MERI PYAS BHUJANA PYASI HAI
SAKINA(SA).
english translation text:
One cup became available on the night of
loneliness. I placed that cup beside Asghar's grave.
My beloved brother was even younger than me.
I would have felt ashamed to drink while
my uncle remained thirsty. Now come and quench
my thirst with your own hands—Sakina is thirsty.

arabic text:
IK RASSI MEIN HUM SAB KE GALE BANDH KE AADA.
KARTE HOWAY TASHEER CHALE JANIB-E-KUFA.
OUR OSS PE MUSIBAT YE THI QAD CHOTA THA MERA.
UTHTI THI JO PHUPHIYAAN TU GALA KHICHTA THA MERA.
GARDAN KA MERE ZAKHM CHACHA DEKHNE AANA PYASI HAI
SAKINA(SA).
english translation text:
The enemies tied all our necks within
one rope and paraded us towards Kufa.
Another hardship was that I was so
short: whenever my aunts rose, the rope
pulled at my throat. Uncle, come and see
the wound upon my neck—Sakina is thirsty.

arabic text:
JIS ROZ SE ASGHAR(AS) KO MILA BABA KA SEENA.
OSS ROZ SE AMMO NAHI SO PAYI SAKINA(SA).
ISS HAAL MEIN JAON GI MAIN KIS TARHA MADINA.
AA JAYE MAUT HAI KIS KAM KA JEENA.
JAGI HOON BOHAT AA KE CHACHA MUJHE SOLANA PYASI HAI
SAKINA(SA).
english translation text:
Since Asghar received Baba's chest, Sakina has
not slept. How can I return to
Madina in this condition? May death come—what
purpose is left in life? I have
remained awake for so long; come, uncle,
and put me to sleep—Sakina is thirsty.

arabic text:
GHAR LAUT KE JATE HAIN HAR IK SHAM PARINDE.
QISMAT MEIN LIKHE HAIN MERI ZINDAAN KE ANDHERE.
KAB TAK MAIN JEYON GI YOUNHI ASHKON KE SAHARE.
LAGTA HAI KEH MAR JAON GI AB DOOR WATAN SE.
HO GA NA MUYASAR MUJHE GHAR LAUT KE JANA PYASI HAI
SAKINA(SA).
english translation text:
Every evening, the birds return to their
homes; yet darkness of prison is written
in my destiny. How long can I live
only upon tears? It seems I will
die far from my homeland and never receive
the chance to return home—Sakina is thirsty.

arabic text:
ANWAR: YE SADA PARCHAM-E-ABBAS(AS) SE AYI.
MAIN BHOOL NAHI SAKTA SAKINA(SA) MERI BACHI.
KATE GAYE BAZU MERE MAJBOOR THA BIBI(SA).
MASHKEEZA ALAM MEIN HAI LAGA DEKH LE AB BHI.
PARCHAM KA MERE KAM HAI DUNYA KO BATANA PYASI HAI
SAKINA(SA).
english translation text:
Anwar says: this voice came from Abbas's standard:
I can never forget you, my child Sakina.
My arms were severed; I was helpless, O
Lady. Even now, the water-skin hangs upon
my standard. The purpose of my standard is
to tell the world: Sakina is thirsty.
